Description: Founded in 2009 as a residential roofing company, Houston Roofing & Construction has expanded to provide roofing and siding services across residential, commercial, and multifamily properties throughout the greater Houston area. Their leadership team brings commercial construction experience, and the company operates with in-house project managers providing structured project oversight.
Core offering: The company offers commercial and residential roof replacement, repair, inspections, coatings, and siding installation. For commercial and multifamily structures, they specialize in flat and low-slope systems such as TPO, modified bitumen, PVC, and metal roofing.
Target audience: Houston Roofing & Construction serves local homeowners, commercial property owners, businesses, property managers, and multifamily communities such as apartments and townhomes across the Houston metropolitan area.
B2B rationale: Houston Roofing & Construction provides explicit commercial and multifamily roofing services, specifically serving businesses, commercial properties, and property managers.
Discovery questions:
1. How do your project managers handle installation scheduling and staging on active commercial properties to ensure operations stay uninterrupted?
2. What operational protocols do your teams implement to execute tenant-aware installations across multifamily and apartment complexes?
3. When commercial clients evaluate recurring leak repairs versus full system replacement, what framework do you use to assess whether a coating or full tear-off is the better investment?

Description: BrightPlay Turf is a Chicago-based artificial grass and turf installation company providing low-maintenance outdoor solutions for residential and commercial properties.
Core offering: The company installs custom artificial grass and turf as well as landscaping solutions designed for long-term use and low maintenance.
Target audience: BrightPlay Turf serves residential and commercial property owners, businesses, and sports areas throughout the Chicago area.
B2B rationale: The company explicitly states that it installs turf for businesses and commercial properties alongside residential clients.
Discovery questions:
1. How do your installation workflows and project timelines differ when working on commercial properties compared to residential jobs?
2. What unique technical or material specifications do you typically address when installing artificial grass for sports areas?
3. How are your comprehensive landscaping solutions bundled or managed alongside artificial turf installations for commercial clients?

Description: King of the Hill is a landscaping and lawn care company offering design, maintenance, and installation services for properties ranging from residential homes to commercial sites.
Core offering: The company offers lawn maintenance, planting, sodding, tree services, pavers for walkways/driveways/patios, pest and weed control, landscape design, irrigation systems, soil erosion control, and fencing.
Target audience: The business caters to both residential homeowners and commercial property clients.
B2B rationale: The company explicitly provides landscaping and maintenance services to commercial properties alongside residential clients.
Discovery questions:
1. How do your service agreements and scheduling differ when managing commercial properties versus residential accounts?
2. What sustainable practices or materials do commercial clients most frequently request when you design landscapes for them?
3. What challenges do you face when handling larger scope installations like water and drip irrigation systems or hardscape pavers?

Description: Denver Lock And Safe is a 24/7 mobile locksmith service provider based in Denver, Colorado, delivering automotive, residential, and commercial security and lock services.
Core offering: The company offers comprehensive commercial lock and security services, including hierarchical master key setups, emergency exit push bars, digital keypad locks, commercial lockout solutions, safe installations, and contractual security inspections.
Target audience: Their target audience encompasses businesses, office facilities, and commercial clients seeking entry point security, along with automotive and residential property owners across the Denver area.
B2B rationale: Denver Lock And Safe clearly qualifies as B2B because they offer tailored commercial locksmith solutions, office door security, and ongoing contractual inspections for businesses.
Discovery questions:
1. How do you typically structure and manage recurring contractual inspections for your commercial property clients?
2. What challenges do your business clients most often face when configuring and expanding hierarchical master key systems across their facilities?
3. What criteria do you evaluate when helping commercial offices decide between standard exit devices and advanced emergency exit push bars?

Description: The Classic Catering People is a Baltimore-based full-service catering company that organizes and caters both private and corporate events, providing culinary offerings and event management services.
Core offering: The company offers full-service event catering, corporate menus, and event coordination, including the provision and coordination of rentals, linens, table settings, service staff, and overall event flow.
Target audience: The company caters to both private clients for weddings and celebrations and commercial organizations, including large corporations, small startups, government contractors, and creative hubs.
B2B rationale: The company explicitly provides corporate catering services to organizations including startups, large corporations, and government contractors for business events and workplace dining.
Discovery questions:
1. How do you tailor your catering services and menu planning across the diverse range of corporate events you handle, from casual Friday happy hours to formal black tie banquets?
2. What operational bottlenecks do you experience when coordinating external event logistics like rentals, linens, and service staff for large full-service events?
3. How has client demand evolved for your drop-off corporate menus aimed at workplace milestones such as big pitches, wins, and new hires?

Description: Piedmont Moving Systems is a family-owned commercial moving and logistics provider founded in 1981 and based in San Jose, California. The company operates under an ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system and manages an 84,000-square-foot facility providing storage and transport for high-value assets across the Bay Area.
Core offering: The company offers commercial moves, office and corporate relocations, data center and lab relocations, high-value specialized freight transport, and commercial warehouse storage. Its warehousing services include inventory management with item-level tracking, cross-docking, white-glove delivery, and commercial equipment auctions for facility closures.
Target audience: Piedmont Moving Systems serves businesses and commercial organizations in sectors such as healthcare, biotechnology/life sciences, high technology, telecommunications, hospitality (hotels), retail, and industrial facilities requiring specialized transport, project logistics, or commercial storage.
B2B rationale: Piedmont Moving Systems exclusively focuses on business and commercial clients, offering corporate office moves, lab and data center relocations, and commercial warehousing to sectors such as healthcare, tech, and hospitality.
Discovery questions:
1. How do your dedicated move coordinators manage risk and minimize business downtime when handling sensitive IT infrastructure during data center relocations?
2. How does your ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system influence your documented handling and tracking procedures for biotech and healthcare equipment?
3. When corporate clients decommission an office or facility, how do you typically integrate your equipment auction services alongside your moving and storage operations?
